title: Images Added where the Registration on File Has Lapsed
content:
Where the registration on file for a Keyturn Vehicle Listing stands past its expiry, images are added to the figure the marketplace holds, and how many turns on whether the listing is suspended.

1. A vehicle whose registration on file stands more than 7 calendar days past its expiry and whose listing is suspended adds 4 images.

2. A vehicle whose registration on file stands more than 7 calendar days past its expiry and whose listing is not suspended adds 2 images.

3. Any other vehicle adds nothing on this ground, an addition of 0 images.

### Points of judgement

*The day count.* Both of the first two clauses need the registration to stand **more than** 7 calendar days past its expiry. A registration exactly 7 calendar days past expiry is on neither of them and falls to the third clause, as does one that is not past its expiry at all.

*The standing of the listing.* Where the day count is met, the split is the suspension: a suspended listing adds 4 images, a listing in any other standing adds 2.

*Worked on hypothetical records.* A registration 40 calendar days past expiry on a suspended listing adds 4 images. The same registration on a live listing adds 2 images. A registration 5 calendar days past its expiry, and a registration three months short of its expiry, each add nothing on this ground.
